product_metadata.title: Chardin home - 100% Cotton Reversible Bathroom 2-Piece Bath Rug Set – 21”x34” & 17”x24”, Loop/Cut Pattern Absorbent Super Soft Comfort Quick Dry Durable Hotel Spa mats, Machine Washable, Beige
features: COMFORTABLE AND REVERSIBLE - Give your bathroom a refreshing look with our Cotton Reversible bathmat set featuring loop on one side & cut pile on reverse. These comfortable rugs offer a dry and cozy place to stand when you step out of the shower. These rugs are fully reversible with soft 100% cotton material on both sides offering plush comfort to your feet. Use both sides and get twice the rug.

QUICK DRY AND WATER ABSORBENT- 100% Cotton yarns are densely tufted together to make a soft yet super absorbent surface. The mat's superb construction allows the water held in the mat to dry quickly and keep bathroom floors dry & clean.

VERSATILE USE: Classic solid mats will match with any current aesthetic. Will fit any modern farmhouse boho bohemian country cabin home or office décor. Use them in your bathrooms, kitchen, entry way, bedroom, garage, patio, apartment, kids-room or as throw rugs anywhere in the house. Pets Love them too.

RUG SET: Our hand-crafted two-piece set has large rectangular rug 21x34 & small bathmat is 17x24. Easy to combine with your existing home décor. These can be easily folded and put away when needed. Our rug set is reversible so no rubber backing issues in the washer. We do recommend using non-slip rug pad for extra grip.

EASY WASH CARE - Machine wash separately using cold water and mild soap. Do not bleach. Remove rug from dryer and shake well when almost dry, this will prolong life of the rug. Shaking will fluff up the rug and will be good to use again
